Create a COMPLETELY NEW Glass Cannon Joker card for the Risk family in a Balatro mod. The user's latest direction overrides a plain cannon: it must be more original, striking, grotesque and recognizably related to the other Risk Jokers.
REFERENCE1 Greed and REFERENCE2 Burning Fuse are STYLE/FAMILY REFERENCES ONLY: use their red-black malicious jester humor, thin brick-red card frame, neutral ivory paper, low-resolution pixel art, strong centered composition. Do NOT copy either character or their objects.
NEW CONCEPT: a cursed carnival GLASS CANNON shaped like a leering jester. Center one large squat ice-cyan glass cannon angled diagonally upward right on two chunky dark-red wooden wheels. Its flared muzzle is an unmistakable hollow barrel opening shaped like a crooked laughing jester mouth: ONE dark navy interior, a few asymmetric sharp pale glass teeth along the lower lip, two slanted off-white eye-shaped reflections just above it. Rear barrel has a small two-point red-and-black jester cap, one tip lit like a short fuse. TWO large clean dark cracks split the pale cyan barrel; a small missing glass chip at the lip conveys imminent catastrophic breakage. Glass body stays mostly pale blue, thick navy contours, two angular white glints. Restrained red-black carriage, large simple spoked wheels. A wicked, untrustworthy fairground contraption, playfully grotesque and dangerous, with strong personality. No gore, no human injury. This should feel like a custom Balatro Risk Joker, not a generic artillery icon.
VISUAL CLARITY: bold single compact readable silhouette; 71x95 logical pixel art with chunky pixel clusters, limited12-16 colors, broad FLAT color fills, maximum one hard shadow step. No gradients, no airbrush, no strange soft shadows, no gray haze, no ground shadow, no photorealistic transparency, no highly detailed rendering. Keep art separated from lettering and border.
CARD: full-frame71:95 portrait. Completely OPAQUE clean neutral ivory paper RGB235,235,229, never yellow or brown, no dirt. Single thin muted brick-red border#98433e at canvas edges. Vertical JOKER left, inverted counterpart right. Entire image is a solid printed card; no external margins. Full-bleed opaque sprite ready to shrink. No captions, no watermark.
specs.status: selected: new Risk cannon from scratch; previous drafts discarded
